header: Platform releases from March to June 2026

items.title: Funnels can branch on any event property
items.description: A funnel step can now split on a property, so you can compare card and invoice checkouts in one report. Existing funnels work as before.

items.title: Cohort exports over 5 million rows now finish
items.description: Retention exports above about 5 million rows failed after 300 seconds. They now run in the background and end with a signed download link. Brannen Health reported the issue.

items.title: The v1 track endpoint is retired
items.description: From this release, events sent to /v1/track are rejected. Use /v2/events, which takes the same payload plus a workspace key in the header. SDKs from version 3.0 already use it.
